definition.name: Authenticated private Go dependencies and offline signed lifecycle

steps.name: Require both artifact IDs from this run's ordinary Go build
Download the same run's frozen node, tools and companion packages
Download the same run's pinned Go compiler and generator
Restore current-source Go tools and compiler isolation
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
python3 -m pip install -r tools/requirements.lock
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install --yes bubblewrap
sudo sysctl -w kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=0
mv -- "$RUNNER_TEMP/go-native-transfer/go-capsule-authoring" "$RUNNER_TEMP/go-capsule-authoring"
python3 -B - <<'PY'
import os
from pathlib import Path
from tools.qualify_go_entropy_retained import reproduction_tools
from tools.qualify_go_private_dependencies import frozen
root = Path(os.environ['RUNNER_TEMP'])
reproduction_tools(root / 'go-guest-tools')
_, products, _ = frozen(root / 'go-capsule-authoring')
for product in products.values():
    product.chmod(0o700)
PY
out="$RUNNER_TEMP/go-guest-tools"
test "$("$out/componentize-go" --version)" = 'componentize-go 0.4.3'
test "$("$out/wasm-tools" --version)" = 'wasm-tools 1.254.0 (bb58fdf91 2026-07-20)'
tar -xzf "$out/go.tar.gz" -C "$out"
python3 -B tools/go_guest/runtime.py --prepare-compiler "$out/go" --output "$out/go-async"
echo "$out" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
echo "$out/go-async/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

steps.name: Check private proxy trust, native capture and signed campaign boundaries
Qualify authenticated private Go graphs and offline signed lifecycle
Retain the private captures, rebuild evidence and signed node observations

${{ runner.temp }}/go-private-dependencies/offline-rebuild/build-observation.json
${{ runner.temp }}/go-private-dependencies/offline-rebuild-evidence.json
${{ runner.temp }}/go-private-dependencies/node-*/workflow.json
${{ runner.temp }}/go-private-dependencies/node-*/FAILED.json

reviewReason: Move both private Go dependency checks and their ten retained evidence selectors to the bounded downstream job. Two hosted one-hour runs finished all tests and were cancelled during finalization. The new job authenticates the original ordinary native products and both same-run artifacts before running the unchanged commands.
